consent.title: Consent & signature
consent.text:
In accordance with Moroccan Law No. 09-08 on the protection of individuals with regard to the processing of personal data, {riad} processes the data collected here (identity, travel document, contact details and signature) to register your stay and to meet its legal obligation to declare guests to the authorities (police form).

Only authorised riad staff and the competent authorities can access this data. The photo of your document is deleted {days} days after your departure; the register details are kept for the period required by law.

You have the right to access, correct and object to this processing, which you can exercise with {email}. This processing has been declared to the CNDP (Moroccan data protection authority).
